description: Schema-only Meta tables observed in DEV/staging on 2026-09-19; no rows or credentials. Foreign keys are retained.

ddl.MetaConnections:
CREATE TABLE `MetaConnections` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `metaUserId` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'ID del usuario de Meta (número grande como string)',
  `accessToken` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `expiresAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `userName` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `userEmail` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uniq_meta_connections_user_provider` (`userId`,`metaUserId`),
  KEY `idx_meta_connections_user_id` (`userId`),
  KEY `idx_meta_connections_provider_id` (`metaUserId`),
  CONSTRAINT `MetaConnections_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `Usuarios` (`id_usuario`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.ClinicMetaAssets:
CREATE TABLE `ClinicMetaAssets` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `clinicaId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `metaConnectionId` int NOT NULL,
  `metaAssetId` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'ID único del activo en Meta',
  `metaAssetName` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Nombre descriptivo del activo',
  `pageAccessToken` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Page Access Token específico (solo para facebook_page)',
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `assetAvatarUrl` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'URL del avatar/icono del activo (página, perfil, etc.)',
  `additionalData` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Datos adicionales del activo (followers, categoría, verificación, etc.)',
  `isActive` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'Si el mapeo está activo o deshabilitado',
  `assetType` enum('facebook_page','instagram_business','ad_account','whatsapp_business_account','whatsapp_phone_number') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tipo de activo de Meta',
  `ad_account_status` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `ad_account_disable_reason` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ad_account_spend_cap` decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ad_account_amount_spent` decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ad_account_refreshed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `grupoClinicaId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `assignmentScope` enum('unassigned','clinic','group') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'clinic' COMMENT 'Indica si el activo se asigna a una clínica específica, al grupo completo o queda sin asignar',
  `wabaId` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phoneNumberId` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `waVerifiedName` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `quality_rating` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `messaging_limit` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `waAccessToken` text,
  `meta_billed_by` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_clinic_asset` (`clinicaId`,`assetType`,`metaAssetId`),
  KEY `idx_clinic_meta_assets_is_active` (`isActive`),
  KEY `idx_clinic_meta_assets_type_active` (`assetType`,`isActive`),
  KEY `idx_clinic_meta_assets_clinica_active` (`clinicaId`,`isActive`),
  KEY `idx_clinic_meta_assets_group_active` (`grupoClinicaId`,`isActive`),
  KEY `idx_clinic_meta_assets_phone_number` (`phoneNumberId`),
  KEY `idx_clinic_meta_assets_waba` (`wabaId`),
  KEY `clinic_meta_assets_is_active` (`isActive`),
  KEY `clinic_meta_assets_asset_type_is_active` (`assetType`,`isActive`),
  KEY `clinic_meta_assets_clinica_id_is_active` (`clinicaId`,`isActive`),
  KEY `clinic_meta_assets_grupo_clinica_id_is_active` (`grupoClinicaId`,`isActive`),
  KEY `idx_clinic_meta_assets_connection` (`metaConnectionId`),
  CONSTRAINT `ClinicMetaAssets_grupoClinicaId_foreign_idx` FOREIGN KEY (`grupoClinicaId`) REFERENCES `GruposClinicas` (`id_grupo`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ClinicMetaAssets_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`clinicaId`) REFERENCES `Clinicas` (`id_clinica`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ClinicMetaAssets_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`metaConnectionId`) REFERENCES `MetaConnections` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
